proposal.summary: An integer overflow in initialize_typed_array_from_array_buffer in LibJS/Runtime/TypedArray.cpp in SerenityOS allows memory manipulation; an exploit has been publicly disclosed. A patch (f6c6047e49f1517778f5565681fb64750b14bf60) is available.
proposal.affected_product: SerenityOS (rolling releases, no specific versions available)
proposal.cwe_quote: The manipulation leads to integer overflow.

AV.quote: An exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

C.quote: The manipulation leads to integer overflow.

I.quote: The manipulation leads to integer overflow.

A.quote: The manipulation leads to integer overflow.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Apply the provided patch f6c6047e49f1517778f5565681fb64750b14bf60 to affected SerenityOS installations and notify downstream consumers; if patching is not immediately possible, implement mitigations such as disabling vulnerable JS features or restricting untrusted content execution.

evidence_quotes.quote: Affected by this issue is the function initialize_typed_array_from_array_buffer in the library Userland/Libraries/LibJS/Runtime/TypedArray.cpp.
The manipulation leads to integer overflow.
The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.
The patch is identified as f6c6047e49f1517778f5565681fb64750b14bf60.
Continious delivery with rolling releases is used by this product. Therefore, no version details of affected nor updated releases are available.
